text: The Sep. 26 edition listed 11 of the 13 Fairbanks filings for Sep. 25. The two omitted cases, 4FA-26-01922CR and 4FA-26-01926CR (both theft 4), have been added.
Earlier editions stated that no Fourth District grand jury indictment had appeared since Sep. 2. An indictment in 4FA-26-01446CR was returned Sep. 9.
